items.title: 1.7.8 Dhaati kirdar (metallic character) mein tabdeeli (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.7.8, printed pages 14-15.

blocks.text: Unsur ka dhaati kirdar (metallic character) us ka electrons khone ka rujhan hai. Periodic table ki baen taraf ke anasir noble gas configuration hasil karne ke liye apne bairooni electrons khone ka zyada rujhan rakhte hain, jab ke daen taraf ke anasir electrons lene ka. To baen taraf ke anasir metals hain jo musbat ions banate hain, aur daen taraf, khaas kar daen kone, ke anasir non-metals hain jo manfi ions banate hain; unsur ka dhaati kirdar bari had tak us ke valence shell ki electronic configuration par munhasir hai.

blocks.alt: Periodic table ka gulabi khaaka jis par Metallic Character likha hai, chaar teeron ke saath: oopar 'increasing metallic character' baen ki taraf; baen taraf 'increasing metallic character' neeche ki taraf; daen taraf 'increasing nonmetallic character' oopar ki taraf; neeche 'increasing nonmetallic character' daen ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Fig 1.3: Anasir ke dhaati kirdar (metallic character) ke aam rujhanaat (kitab ki Fig 1.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Period mein baen se daen nuclear charge barhta aur atomic jasamat ghat'ti hai, jo electron cloud ko nucleus ke qareeb kheenchti aur atom ke liye electrons khona mushkil banati hai, to dhaati kirdar ghat'ta hai. Group mein neeche dhaati kirdar barhta hai, kyunke atomic jasamat aur shielding effect barhte hain aur valence electrons par nuclear kashish kam karte hain. Dhaati kirdar mein izafa, electron khone ki asani, unsur ko zyada reactive banata hai: cesium sodium ya lithium se kahin zyada reactive aur electropositive hai.

blocks.caption: Dhaati aur ghair-dhaati kirdar
rows: Nuclear charge zyada, jasamat kam: electrons mazbooti se pakre
Jasamat aur shielding zyada: valence electrons asani se khote hain

blocks.prompt: Batayein ke group 14 mein dhaati kirdar kaise badalta hai, aur silicon aur germanium semimetals kyun hain.
blocks.explanation: Group 14 carbon, ek non-metal, se silicon aur germanium, metalloids, se ho kar tin aur lead, jo metals hain, tak jata hai: dhaati kirdar group mein neeche barhta hai jaise atoms barhte aur valence electrons behtar shield hote hain. Silicon aur germanium metals aur non-metals ke darmiyan stair-step lakeer par hain aur dono ki kuch khusoosiyat dikhate hain, to semimetals hain.

items: Dhaati kirdar electrons khone ka rujhan hai; yeh valence shell configuration par munhasir hai.
Yeh period mein ghat'ta aur group mein neeche barhta hai, to metals ke groups mein neeche reactivity barhti hai: cesium sodium ya lithium se kahin zyada reactive hai.
